card.name: Swiss phone numbers and Swiss institutions
card.fires_on: Digits of a Swiss phone number after the +41 country code, and words inside Swiss institution names such as École Polytechnique Fédérale. It also fires on journal reference numbers in a Swiss-linked citation.

modes.label: Swiss phone digits
modes.description: Digits and spaces in a phone number that begins with the +41 country code.

modes.label: Swiss institution names
modes.description: Parts of names of Swiss research bodies, inside or after the word Swiss or Switzerland.

card.plain: It notices text that points to Switzerland, such as +41 phone numbers and Swiss institute names, and primes the model to expect Swiss place names.
